name: Kick Up Dust

source.title: Paizo Blog: Foolish Housekeeping and Other Articles

text:
Frequency once per hour

---
Effect Your dust bunny shakes and kicks to stir up dust in a 5-foot emanation. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that fails its save begins sneezing uncontrollably and is Slowed 1 and cannot take reactions for 1 round; on a critical failure they are Slowed 2.
